description: Given one opinion id, returns other opinions whose wording overlaps it, ranked by keyword match (BM25 more-like-this). Keyword overlap only: not a finding that the neighbors address the same issue, reach the same result or remain good law, and not complete. The seed opinion and its own case are excluded. Case law in this mirror ends 2026-09-30 (exact scan of all 10,174,547 case records): a thin or empty result for recent authority means the collection ends there, not that no such case exists. Responses carry body_as_of, body_pending (state, exact count, read_at) and body_note, which say when the stored opinion text is older than the case records while a refresh is written; a count that could not be read makes an empty result inconclusive. A cold index may answer 503 briefly; the server retries once. Every response carries a "note" stating that response’s source and coverage limits.
